dedupe_keys.name: 名古屋市 ため池ハサートマッフ irrigation and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 【名古屋市】ため池ハザードマップ [irrigation and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 地震等の自然災害により、ため池の堤体に、万が一異常が生じ、決壊した場合に想定される浸水区域、浸水深および到達時間をシミュレーションにより算出したものです。. Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are ハザードマップ, 名古屋市, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
